articles.summary: Nextpower (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power technology solutions, today announced that it will host its Capital Markets Day in Las Vegas, Nevada on Monday, November 16, 2026, beginning at 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time / 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The event will include presentations from Nextpower’s senior leadership team on the Company’s growth strategy and progress against its long-term financial targets, followed by a live QA session. Due to limited capacity, attendance in person is by invitation only. A live webcast of the event will be available on the Nextpower Investor Relations website . A replay will be posted to the same website shortly after the event concludes.
